translation.GTS: Gabriel Terra Simões - Software Engineering Student, UNAERP
translation.GRP: Gabriel Reverso Pereira - Computer Engineering Student, UNAERP
translation.dev_note2: Codap was created by two computer engineering students from the University of Ribeirão Preto - UNAERP - being the winner of the 14th computer challenge at the university. Our intention with Codap is to expand the horizon of knowledge and, at the same time, bring part of what can be done with WEB development to people who are curious or want to start out as a WEB developer. We hope you have a good journey of getting to know each other with Cody, our faithful helper.

read.title: Read it calmly
read.text: Cody introduces the idea and the explanation follows. The colored words are the most important ones.

tabs.title: Explore the code
tabs.text: Tap the tabs to see each file. The Web tab shows the real result, like in a browser.

run.title: Run it and see
run.text: When there is a Run button, tap it to run the code. The output shows up right below.

next.title: Tap Next
next.text: Done reading? Move on to the next screen. The bar at the top shows how much is left.

read.title: Read the question
read.text: Some come with a code snippet. Read carefully before choosing.

choose.title: Pick an answer
choose.text: Tap the one you think is right. Changed your mind? Just tap another.

check.title: Confirm with Next
check.text: The app checks your answer right away and shows whether you got it.

see.title: Find the blanks
see.text: The code has empty spaces (___). Each one waits for a block.

fill.title: Tap the blocks
fill.text: Each tap fills the next blank, in code order. Careful: some blocks are traps!

undo.title: Changed your mind?
undo.text: Tap a filled blank to give the block back. When everything is right, tap Next.

see.title: Find what is missing
see.text: The code has one blank (___). The question tells you what to type.

type.title: Type the answer
type.text: Write in the field below the code and watch the blank fill in. The keyboard does not autocorrect or capitalize.

check.title: Check it
check.text: Tap Next, or the keyboard Enter, to check.

see.title: Lines out of order
see.text: The code lines show up shuffled. The question tells you what to build and in what order. Some lines may be extra!

place.title: Tap in the right order
place.text: Each tap sends the line to the next position. Indentation appears on its own.

undo.title: Fix it when needed
undo.text: Tap a placed line to give it back: the ones below move up. With the right order, tap Next.

see.title: Two sides, right pairs
see.text: Each item on one side matches an item on the other.

pair.title: Tap one on each side
pair.text: You can start from either column. A right pair turns green and locks.

wrong.title: Wrong? Try again
wrong.text: A wrong pair flashes red and the selection clears. Match every pair to move on.

fill.title: Complete the blanks
fill.text: Tap the blocks to build the code, just like the completing exercise.

run.title: Tap Run
run.text: The code really runs. You see the page preview and the console right below.

verdict.title: See if it worked
verdict.text: The app checks what the code does. If it has not worked yet, swap the blocks and run again: any combination that works counts.

read.title: Read the requirements
read.text: The challenge lists what your code must do. Each requirement becomes a checked item.

type.title: Type the code
type.text: The editor starts with a head start. The symbol bar above the keyboard helps with < > / = and indentation.

run.title: Run and check
run.text: Tap Run: the Result tab shows ✓ or ✗ for each requirement. Pass them all to finish.

hints.title: Need help?
hints.text: Hints and the solution open after every 2 failed attempts or every 90 seconds. The Instant Hint, bought in the Market, opens right away.

codeSection.timeout: This is taking longer than expected. There may be an infinite loop in the code.
